title: Vertex AI MaaS raw proxy drops the /openapi segment from the upstream URL
answers: Vertex AI MaaS model proxy request returns 404 or hits the wrong endpoint
gateway proxy route to Llama or Mistral on Vertex builds endpoints/chat/completions without openapi
raw proxy to partner models on Vertex AI uses the wrong URL path
body:
Symptom: Calling the AI Gateway raw proxy route (/gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/...) for a Vertex AI MaaS model (Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek) sends the request to .../endpoints/chat/completions instead of .../endpoints/openapi/chat/completions.
Root cause: OpenAICompatibleProvider._proxy strips the last segment of _api_base to undo a trailing /v1, which wrongly removes /openapi from _VertexAIMaaSProvider._api_base.
Fix pattern: Override _proxy on _VertexAIMaaSProvider to post to self._api_base unchanged, and drop only a leading "v1/" (and leading slash) from the caller's path.
Constraints: Applies to MaaS providers whose base URL ends in a path segment that belongs to the API root. Other providers keep the base _proxy behaviour that strips /v1.
applies: Vertex AI MaaS provider raw proxy path construction in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py.
says: Raw proxy requests to partner models like Llama or Mistral on Vertex return not found.
The AI gateway raw proxy sends chat requests to the wrong endpoint path on Vertex.
Fix gateway proxy routing so requests reach open-source models hosted on Google Cloud correctly.
Calling DeepSeek models through the gateway raw proxy route fails because the URL is truncated.
Preserve the required upstream API path segments when proxying requests to third-party models on Vertex.
search: For Vertex AI MaaS models such as Llama, Mistral, and DeepSeek, the raw proxy route in _VertexAIMaaSProvider._proxy must post directly to _api_base without stripping the /openapi path segment. Unlike OpenAICompatibleProvider._proxy which removes the trailing segment to strip /v1, _VertexAIMaaSProvider overrides _proxy to retain _api_base and strip only a leading 'v1/' or slash from the caller path. This override applies exclusively to MaaS providers whose base URL ends with an API root segment, while other providers retain the standard /v1 stripping behavior.
